description: List companies of a CNAE sector (1-4 characters: section letter, 2-digit division such as "62" for IT programming/consulting, or a longer code), optionally within one province. Sorted by BORME activity by default; with `province` use sort=recent (default) or oldest. Use for prospecting and market mapping; 20 per page, offset up to 1000. Find codes with borme_get_cnae_tree.

cnae.description: CNAE-2009 code: a section letter (e.g. "J"), a 2-digit division (e.g. "62") or a longer numeric code.

sort.description: Order: acts (most BORME activity, default without province), recent, oldest, name. With `province` only recent (default) and oldest are accepted.

name: borme_list_sector_companies
